{{Quote|This is Captain Silverline, Imperial Authoritarian of the Emperor's Navy.|Captain Silverline|<ref name="SWG:AER">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Emergency Report}}</ref>}}
'''Silverline''' was a [[TIE pilot|pilot]] and [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|While patrolling Area D-512, we spotted a group of unidentified flying starships. They only spat out threats in response to our friendly hails which resulted in hostile, open fire directed toward us. I lost most of my men to these... hooligans!|Captain Silverline|<ref name="SWG:AER" />}}
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Silverline served in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and held the position of [[Imperial Authoritarian]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During a patrol mission in the [[Area D-512]] of the Naboo system, Captain Silverline's squadron was ambushed by a mysterious group of starships and suffered heavy casualties. Silverline was not able to identify the assailants but reported that they were probably [[Droid/Legends|droids]], piloting starships similar to those used by [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Furthermore, their leader referred itself as the [[OT-Violator]]. This hostile force was code-named [[Penumbra Omen]] and the entire quadrant was eventually prohibited to travel.<ref name="SWG:AER" /> Captain Silverline's emergency report was later intercepted by [[Fghai'g Windrunner]], a pilot of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] who considered to explore the Penumbra Omen quadrant.<ref name="SWG:APR">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|A Patrol Report}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Captain Silverline still served in the Naboo system where he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[TIE Oppressor]].<ref name="SWG:CSIA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silverline appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CSIA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Silverline was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:CSIA" />
